correctness.rationale: The normalized F4 roots decompose into two 24-cell antipodal orbits. The S3 addition theorem equates evaluation rank to the zonal U_ell Gram rank. The 24-by-24 parity reduction and exact Chebyshev value tables are algebraic. The included checker constructs the exact integer congruence matrices and uses rational Gaussian elimination for every unbounded-tail exception, yielding the claimed finite rank profile; an independent symbolic implementation agreed at nine key exceptional degrees. Diagonal dominance proves all odd ell>=19 and all even ell>=24; no finite-to-infinite extrapolation is made. Proof covers ell=0 and all parity boundaries.

originality.rationale: Full-text comparison with directly relevant Hirao–Nozaki–Tasaka 2025 shows a precise conceptual distinction: the known harmonic-strength theorem detects only constant-vector annihilation, not the rank of every evaluation image. Degrees 8 and 16 are rank-deficient even though neither is in the 2025 even harmonic-strength set. Earlier D4 and E8 rank claims cover different point sets. Four targeted published-finding corpus searches did not surface a corresponding F4 all-degree table; unindexed finite-group representation literature remains a residual risk.

value.rationale: The canonical 48-point normalized F4 root configuration is also the binary octahedral group and a central spherical design. Exact-degree sampling onto its antipodal parity subspace is a natural harmonic-interpolation invariant. The complete classification identifies a late loss at ell=22 despite earlier full interpolation, and detects hidden nonconstant defects at ell=8,16 not visible in known harmonic-strength classifications. It refines an established mathematical object rather than an arbitrary unmotivated slice.
